description: This file contains shell script functions and variables related to firmware upgrade procedures for various devices in an embedded Linux system, specifically in the context of OpenWrt-based device firmware management. It includes functions for preparing initramfs, handling UBI partitions, device-specific upgrade routines, and control flow for different hardware models.

methods.name: xiaomi_initramfs_prepare
methods.description: Prepares the system for initramfs by wiping UBI if necessary.

methods.name: asus_initial_setup
methods.description: Removes existing linux and jffs2 volumes in UBI.

methods.name: remove_oem_ubi_volume
methods.description: Removes a specified OEM UBI volume if it exists.

methods.name: tplink_get_boot_part
methods.description: Determines the current boot partition based on kernel arguments or U-Boot environment.

methods.name: tplink_do_upgrade
methods.description: Handles UBI partition switching and upgrades for TP-Link devices.

methods.name: linksys_mx_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Pre-upgrade routine for Linksys MX devices, adjusting U-Boot environment variables.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Always returns success, a placeholder for platform-specific image validation.

methods.name: platform_pre_upgrade
methods.description: Performs device-specific pre-upgrade preparations based on device model.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs device-specific upgrade routines depending on the device model.
